title: MOCA citations over AG-UI
description: An AG-UI CUSTOM event that carries the citation records an answer cites. Normative: spec/moca-ag-ui-citations.md.

version.description: The version of this event's value. A client ignores a version it does not know.

messageId.description: The AG-UI messageId of the assistant message that cites these records.

computedAt.description: When the service's Reader computed the records (RFC 3339, with an offset). Trust flags are true at that moment.

citations.description: One entry per cited node, or chunk of a node, in order of first mention in the answer.

marker.description: The text in the answer that refers to this citation, when the host uses markers such as [1].
